# Error.GetErrorListAsMarkdown method

Generates a formatted string containing a list of all application errors, grouped and sorted by their code prefix. The method scans all loaded assemblies for classes that inherit from [`ErrorModule`](../Error.ErrorModule.md).

```csharp
public static string GetErrorListAsMarkdown()
```

## Return Value

A string with the complete error report.
